label: Data quality culture
definition: Requirements for the organisation to establish and sustain a data quality culture.

label: Management of data quality issues
definition: Requirements for processes to communicate, analyse, evaluate, resolve and close data quality issues.

label: Competence management
definition: Requirements for managing skills and competence of persons involved in DQM activities.

label: Resource management
definition: Requirements for providing sufficient resources for DQM activities.

label: Documentation
definition: Requirements for documentation to be intelligible and accessible.

label: Data quality audit and assessment
definition: Requirements for auditing implemented DQM processes.

label: Confirmation review and DQ measures
definition: Requirements for confirming data quality via measures and confirmation reviews.

label: Project-specific DQM
definition: Requirements for project-specific data quality management.

label: Data quality management life cycle General
definition: General requirements for the DQMLC.

label: Data motivation and conceptualization
definition: Requirements for documenting motivation, origin and intended use of data.

label: Stakeholder analysis
definition: Requirements for identifying and engaging stakeholders.

label: Data specification General
definition: Requirements for specifying data requirements consistently and completely.

label: Data format
definition: Requirements for specifying data format.

label: Statistical properties and divisibility
definition: Requirements for specifying statistical properties and subset divisions.

label: Data planning General
definition: Requirements for establishing a data quality plan.

label: Data life cycle specific plans
definition: Requirements for stage-specific planning.

label: Data acquisition General
definition: Requirements for data acquisition processes.

label: Data source delegation
definition: Requirements concerning data source and delegation of acquisition responsibilities.

label: Data collection
definition: Requirements for documenting data collection.

label: Data handling
definition: Requirements for data handling after collection.

label: Data preprocessing General
definition: Requirements for data preprocessing processes.

label: Data cleaning
definition: Requirements for specifying and applying data cleaning measures.

label: Data augmentation General
definition: Requirements for data augmentation processes.

label: Data provisioning General
definition: Requirements for data provisioning processes.

label: Data provisioning documentation
definition: Requirements for documentation provisioned with data.

label: Tracking and improvement
definition: Requirements for tracking provisioned data and improving the provisioning process.

label: Data optimization
definition: Requirements for optimising provisioned data.

label: Support commitment
definition: Requirements for ongoing support commitment for provisioned data.

label: Data decommissioning General
definition: Requirements for decommissioning data.
